query:
SELECT d.id, r.distribution_id as "distribution_id?"
        FROM device d
        LEFT JOIN release r ON r.id = d.release_id
        WHERE
            CASE
                WHEN $1 ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND length($1) <= 10 THEN
                    d.id = $1::int4
                ELSE
                    d.serial_number = $1
            END
